findings.claim: Worktree base read from the oldest reflog 'Created from <X>', but every kit command creating a pass branch omits the start point, so git logs 'Created from HEAD' and no record is ever written for worktree, small or stacked passes.
findings.closure: tracks.md/orchestrate.md/small.md create the branch with an explicit base start point (or the plan names another base source the record hook can read and an agent cannot write), and an LP case builds the branch exactly as tracks.md:131 does and gets base = that branch; it passes.

findings.claim: Rows mode denies any Write and any Edit with no case title in old_string, removing the byte-identical re-save and pure new-case insertion allowed on every frozen file.
findings.closure: Step 5 runs the existing re-save and insertion checks before the per-case check, and two LP cases pass: identical Write on a rows path, pure insertion of U9 on a rows path.

findings.claim: Step 5 identifies touched cases only by titles inside old_string/new_string, so an edit can reach into a case with no row.
findings.closure: Step 5 computes the enclosing case of the edited span in the current file (anchor_scope / enclosing_case_indent) and an LP case with old_string starting in U1's body and ending at U2's title -> deny; it passes.

findings.claim: A path with plan rows cannot take a batch-approved EXECUTE correction of another case.
findings.closure: Step 5 states how a .tdd-unfrozen id with no row on a rows path is honoured, and an LP case (row U2, batch line U5 on the same path, Edit of U5) passes.

findings.claim: The plan gate must print sha256(<new title>) per row but nothing named computes it without a prompt.
findings.closure: The plan names one hash producer runnable without a prompt and not able to write the record, plan.md step 7 uses it, and a case asserts its output for a literal title equals a literal hex digest.

findings.claim: Freeze hook deny texts (the specification) still prescribe one .tdd-unfrozen write per correction and 'the user confirms it at the merge'; no step rewrites them (also implementer.md:46).
findings.closure: Step 5 lists the deny-text rewrite (queue, one batch stop, PR body) in both hooks and implementer.md, and a PK/LP needle asserts the texts name the batch and no longer say 'confirms it at the merge'.

findings.claim: AC1's 'no remote: local flow unchanged' has no case and PK26 asserts the opposite inside 4bis.
findings.closure: A PK case asserts ship.md keeps the no-remote local merge path (with its go-ahead) in a named subsection, and PK26 is scoped to the remote/PR branch of 4bis; both pass.

findings.claim: AC2's PR body loop-PR template order has no case.
findings.closure: A PK case asserts github.md's template lists Frozen cases, Open questions, Review, Gates in that order after Screenshots, with --body-file; it passes.
